cards.text: Open directly on Viviana's on-camera introduction: “Hi, I'm Viviana matsuda. Um, I do pottery for a living. My brand name is Mud Witch.”
Start with Viviana on camera, then cut to establish the studio space with b-roll of the Mud Witch storefront signage.
Establish a warm, inviting tone introducing Viviana and her pottery business, set to a continuous bed of upbeat, dreamy background music (dreamy_upbeat.wav).
Explore how Viviana found her creative identity and shaped the Mud Witch brand.
Viviana narrates her journey of finding her voice and distinctive style for Mud Witch
continuing into her artistic expression
Cut to b-roll of the Mud Witch sign displayed on a studio shelf
followed by close details of her ceramics on display
Highlight the tactile, meditative craft of pottery and the joy Viviana derives from making pieces by hand.
Layer interview reflections on her creative process and daily work
speaking to why she loves what she does
Showcase hands-on pottery creation and studio details through active B-roll of throwing clay
shaping forms
and colorful finished mugs
Conclude with Viviana's core philosophy about keeping life simple and cherishing handmade objects.
Viviana reflects on consumer habits
and concludes with her closing message: “But not only that, but like, you don't need all of that stuff. Like, you could literally just get a couple things that make you happy.”
Cut between finished pottery on studio shelves
and end on the exterior shot of Viviana walking out of the studio as the music gently resolves.
